# PHASE 12 Final direct contract

Developer-only fixture for the direct Shader Pack `final` -> Minecraft main target path.

The pack contains only `final`. Its fragment shader paints pure GREEN. No composite, deferred,
terrain program, colour target, or fallback presenter can manufacture that success colour.

Real-device acceptance requires Metal, a real `final` pass after the world, an F2 screenshot that
is overwhelmingly GREEN, no Vitrail/backend error, and clean shutdown.
